sections.title: Mode ofApproach
sections.text: To visit the station one has to cross the Hooglyriver through Vessels from Lot No.8 Ghat to KachuberiaGhat. Distance from KachuberiaGhat to Lighthouse is approx. 32 Km. Nearest Railway Station is Kakdwip which is approx. 44 Km from Lighthouse.

sections.title: Facilities Available
sections.text: Post Office, Primary Health Center, Police Station and High School all are within 10 KM from Sagar Island Lighthouse.
